correctness.rationale: For rooted perfect binary T_h, ancestor-closed subset concepts include empty ideal and satisfy N_h=1+N_{h-1}^2, yielding 2,5,26,677. The 2^h leaves are VC-shattered, so Ldim>=2^h. For h<=2 cardinality bounds match. For h=3, at any root/internal query the negative branch has respectively 1,27,157 concepts with Ldim at most 0,4,7. At a leaf query the positive branch is the product of three independent sibling ideal classes of heights 0,1,2, with Ldim 1+2+4=7 by standard product additivity. Thus no depth-nine mistake tree exists; Ldim is exactly 8, first strictly less than floor(log2 677)=9. All 0<=h<=3 proof cases handled.
